story: On a Saturday in April, Nina and Omar talk about a big trip. They want to visit a new country. Nina makes hot soup in a brown bowl. Omar helps her with the plates. There are a few plates on the table. There is enough food for the night. Nina is excited about the big meal. Omar holds a plate in his hand. He puts the plate on his head.
title: A Saturday Meal
setting: A bright kitchen and dining room.
